text:
sam_support: FYI customer (Acme) upgraded to redwood-python 1.17.0 and started getting mixed 401/403s + billing surprises.
jackie_support: oof, any repro or stack?
sam_support: minimal repro from them attached: `Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], headers={'X-Project-ID': 'proj-acme'})` then call `.generate(...)`. It used to work on 1.16. They say it silently routed requests to the org default project and tokens charged there. Logs show 403 with mismatched project id.
chris_runtime: can you paste the exact init snippet and the response headers/log trace id?
sam_support: paste from customer (sanitized):
```
# customer code
from redwood import Client
import os
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), headers={'X-Project-ID':'proj-acme'})
resp = c.generate("Summarize this...")
print(resp)
```
Logs: `RequestID: rwd-9f3b; status=403; error="project_mismatch"; effective_project=proj-default`
jackie_support: they said they pinned to 1.16 and it worked immediately, so seems like a breaking change in 1.17.
maya_engineer: I missed this in the changelog — we removed the `headers` passthrough param in 1.17 and replaced it with `metadata` to avoid header injection. We intended to raise on the old kwarg but ended up silently swallowing it. That would explain the silent fallback to the control-plane default project header.
sam_support: customer was pretty upset — double-billed on a few hundred requests before noticing. Need mitigation steps and a patch.
chris_runtime: quick mitigation: ask them to pin `redwood==1.16.4` and set explicit project via env `REDWOOD_PROJECT_ID=proj-acme` until we cut a patch. Repro on my machine: I can reproduce with 1.17 by passing `headers=` and seeing no error.
maya_engineer: agreed. I can prep a 1.17.1 patch to re-introduce a runtime check that raises on unknown client kwargs and log a deprecation warning in 1.17.0 if `headers` present. Also adding migration note to the migration guide.
jackie_support: can we offer the customer credits for the mistakenly routed usage? billing team, help? @support-billing? :pleading_face:
deploy-bot: rollback window closed for 1.17.0. Patch will need a hotfix release.
chris_runtime: reproduction steps for eng:
1) pip install redwood==1.17.0
2) run the minimal snippet above with a non-default project id
3) observe `effective_project` in request logs not matching provided header
4) revert to 1.16.4 to confirm behavior flips back

maya_engineer: I'll open a GH issue + PR for 1.17.1. We should also add a post-deploy alert when client kwargs are ignored (count of ignored kwargs).
sam_support: I'll escalate to the account team and suggest temporary pin + env var. Also emailing the customer apology + offer to scope credits after billing ops review.
jackie_support: please add support ticket link here once billing confirms credits.
maya_engineer: PR filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/499 (draft). Hotfix checklist in the PR.
sam_support: thanks — keep us posted. Customer is still blocked on production traffic.
chris_runtime: I can run a canary build and push the check to staging today.
jackie_support: noted, resolving when patch is out. :white_check_mark:
